subject: English
passage: The Garden Café was one of the most popular family-owned restaurants in downtown Portland. ______ by chef Vanessa Hayward, the restaurant was known to offer seasonal menus and a welcoming atmosphere.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of verb forms within a sentence. The nonfinite past participle "created" is correctly used to form a supplementary element that modifies the noun phrase "the restaurant," identifying who established the Garden Café.
